title: Runtime Enforcement for Operationalizing Ethics in Autonomous Systems
reasoning: The paper defines and evaluates an ethics assurance process and enforcement subsystem for autonomous systems (specifically a humanoid care robot). It utilizes ethical principles—such as beneficence, non-maleficence, and autonomy—to derive and benchmark SLEEC (social, legal, ethical, empathetic, and cultural) rules, ensuring the system operates within an ethics-respectful state space.
